annotations.text:
Tap the screen (or use the variant chip) to switch between the New-Testament-only finish and the combined one.

The combined copy is the piece that has to work: it explains why the whole-Bible count moved when what you actually finished was the New Testament.

Tap to switch between the moment lap 2 finishes and three days into lap 3.

The reset problem is solved with dashed tiles: books read in earlier laps stay visible but clearly spent, so a fresh lap never reads as lost progress.

Three date precisions, because people remember "2011" and not a day.

The lock note is load-bearing: it is where the user learns that backfilled read-throughs never reach the feed.
